**Status:** The KDoc fix is ready for a new local commit on `vcfix-manifest-fallback`, on top of `f3d2ab1fd3b`. I have not pushed it, and the new SHA isn't recorded yet. I couldn't run anything after the emulator test, so the commands below are what I would run, and no command output appears in this report.

**What I found on the emulator (API 35)**
I built the playground app with `flutter build apk --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true`, with no `versionCode` in `android {}` or the manifest.
- **Fresh install works.** `adb uninstall`, then `adb install app-arm64-v8a-release.apk`, returned `Success`. `dumpsys package` shows `versionCode=0`.
- **Install over a higher version fails.** I installed a build with `versionCode=7`, then ran `adb install -r` with the same APK. It returned `Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE]`.

So @mboetger is right: the current sentence "builds APKs with no `versionCode`, which Android refuses to install" is wrong. The flag still doesn't help. `configureSplitPerAbiVersionCodes` returns early when the flag is set, so every split APK gets the same `versionCode` (0 when the manifest has none). Play rejects split APKs that share a `versionCode`, and they can't be installed over a build with a higher one.
